paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between IDK error rate and IDK recall for different parameter settings. The x-axis is labeled "IDK error rate" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis is labeled "IDK recall" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

A blue line, marked with 'x' symbols, represents "No 𝒦FP-reg, fixed λ" and begins at approximately (0, 0.0) and increases to approximately (0.25, 0.5). An orange line, marked with '+' symbols, represents "With 𝒦FP-reg, fixed λ" and begins at approximately (0, 0.0) and increases to approximately (0.25, 0.45). A green dashed line, marked with '*' symbols, represents "No 𝒦FP-reg, adaptive λ" and begins at approximately (0, 0.2) and increases to approximately (0.25, 0.5). Finally, a red dashed line, marked with '^' symbols, represents "With 𝒦FP-reg, adaptive λ" and begins at approximately (0, 0.2) and increases to approximately (0.25, 0.5).
